HomeHero.welcomeTitle: Te mau video i māʻitihia nō teie mahana
HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Te mau video e tumu te faʻaroʻo, mai roto mai i tā mātou mau video, nō te faʻaitoito, nō te turai, e nō te faʻatupu i te feruriraa.
HomeHero.morningTitle: ʻIa ora na i teie poipoi! Te tiaʻi nei te mau taime Bibilia o teie mahana.
HomeHero.morningDescription: A haʻamata i tō ʻoe mahana nā roto i te mau taime Bibilia faʻaitoito, nō te turai e nō te faʻateitei i tō ʻoe varua.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: ʻIa ora na i teie avatea! Te mau taime Bibilia nō tō ʻoe mahana.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Te mau parau Bibilia faʻaitoito, e au maitaʻi nō tō ʻoe taime faʻafaʻaearaa i te avatea ʻaore ra nō te tāmau i te faʻaitoitoraa.
HomeHero.eveningTitle: ʻIa ora na i teie ahiahi! A faʻafaʻaea nā roto i te mau taime Bibilia.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Te mau taime Bibilia hau nō te tauturu iā ʻoe ia feruri e ia ite i te tamahanahanaraa a hope ai tō ʻoe mahana.
HomeHero.joinUsTitle: E rave rahi miria taʻata te imi nei
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Ua tae te tau ʻōtiraa. ʻĀmui mai iā mātou nō te poro i te Evanelia i te ao nei nā roto i te mau rāveʻa itenati.
HomeHero.togetherTitle: Faʻaʻite ʻāmui i te ʻāʻamu o Iesu
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Ia faʻaroʻo e ia ite rātou i te here o Iesu nā roto i tō rātou iho reo, i te vāhi iho e vai ra rātou.

Mission.eyebrow: Hāmanihia nō te ʻohipa poro Evanelia nā te ao taʻatoʻa
Mission.headline: ʻAita te poroʻi e taui. Te huru mātaʻitaʻiraa a te taʻata, ʻoia tei taui.
Mission.intro: Te hāmani faʻahou nei mātou i tā mātou mau video e tā mātou mau tauihaa mai te tumu mai, ma te tuu i te ʻohipa huriraa o e rave rahi ʻahuru matahiti i niʻa i te mau tahua e putuputu ai, e mātaʻitaʻi ai, e e tufa ai te taʻata.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Te haʻaputuraa teata i hurihia i te mau reo rahi roa aʻe i te ao nei
Mission.libraryPointDescription: E rave rahi ʻahuru matahiti ʻohipa huriraa, i ravehia e te mau hoa tavini tiʻaturihia, tei faʻatupu i te hōʻē haʻaputuraa e mau tausani reo, ia farerei te taʻata i te ʻāʻamu o Iesu nā roto i te reo e tae hohonu roa i tō rātou ʻāʻau.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Te afaʻi i te mau reo tiʻaturihia i roto i te mau huru ʻāpī
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Te hāmani faʻahou nei mātou i te huru faʻaʻiteraa i te mau ʻāʻamu o te Evanelia nā roto i te hōhoʻa, ma te ʻāmui i te mau huriraa tiʻaturihia e te mau huru ʻāpī, ia tere tiʻamā te poroʻi nā te mau tahua, te mau peu, e te mau ʻāfata hōhoʻa atoʻa.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Hau atu i te hōʻē haʻaputuraa. E pupu ʻohipa tei tonohia.
Mission.teamPointDescription: E pupu ʻohipa nā te ao taʻatoʻa ʻo Jesus Film Project: te mau taʻata huri parau, te mau ʻaravihi hōhoʻa, te mau taʻata faʻanaho, e te mau taʻata hāmani, o te faʻariro nei i te ʻite o e rave rahi ʻahuru matahiti taviniraa ei mau tauihaa nō te feia e faʻatupu nei i te mau pīpī i te mau vāhi atoʻa.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Tā mātou e hāmani i muri aʻe
Mission.nextStepsDescription: E tāʻamu i te feia mātaʻitaʻi i te mau rāveʻa mau i niʻa i tō rātou tere i te pae varua, nō te tauturu iā rātou ia rave i te taahiraa i muri mai i roto i te ʻāmuiraa, te Pāpaʻiraa Moʻa, ʻaore ra te ʻohipa poro Evanelia.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Haʻaputuraa video nō te poro Evanelia
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Te hōʻē haʻaputuraa Kerisetiano rahi e mau tausani video, teata, e mau tauihaa i roto i te mau reo e rave rahi, nō te taviniraa e te poro Evanelia nā te ao taʻatoʻa.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Te mau tauihaa itenati nō te mau taviniraa
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Te faʻatereraa video, te hāponoraa i te mau video, te tāʻamuraa e te feia mātaʻitaʻi, e te hiʻopoʻaraa i te mau nūmera, i hāmanihia nō te tauturu i te mau taviniraa ia tae i te taʻata rahi aʻe ma te manuia.
Mission.inviteHeadline: A tauturu i te hāmani i {accent} o te mau tauihaa nō te ʻohipa poro Evanelia
Mission.inviteBody: Te titau manihini nei mātou i te feia ʻohipa, te mau taʻata hāmani, e te mau hoa ʻohipa ia tomo nā mua. A tāmata nā mua i te mau tauihaa ʻāpī, a hōroʻa i tō ʻoe manaʻo, e a tauturu i te faʻanaho i te mau tauihaa i hāmanihia nō te ʻohipa poro Evanelia mau.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: E iriti i te tahua nō te ʻohipa a Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: E iriti i te tahua nō te ʻohipa a Jesus Film, i te vāhi «Te ʻēʻa i mua»
